description: This Java source file defines the class ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper, which extends AbstractMessageMapper, and is responsible for creating CreateThing signals and mapping them to external messages. It handles placeholder replacements in templates, configuration validation, and integration with the Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: ImplicitThingCreationMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractMessageMapper that maps external messages into CreateThing signals for implicit creation of Things, managing placeholders, configurations, and protocol adaptations.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with properties such as thing template, command headers, and policy lockout option based on provided configuration.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage into an Adaptable containing a CreateThing signal, handling placeholders, headers, and logging.

methods.name: getCreateThingSignal
methods.description: Creates a CreateThing signal based on the resolved template and message headers.

methods.name: resolveCommandHeaders
methods.description: Resolves command headers from the external message headers using an expression resolver.

methods.name: createInlinePolicyJson
methods.description: Extracts inline policy JSON object from the thing JSON, if present.

methods.name: getCopyPolicyFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the copyPolicyFrom value from the thing JSON object.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object back into ExternalMessage(s), particularly in error/response scenarios.
